codeSnippets.output: The row becomes horizontal only on screens 768px and wider.

exercise.instruction: Make .grid responsive: by default it stacks (block). At min-width 640px it becomes a flex row with gap 16px, and each .item gets flex: 1 1 200px. Add the viewport meta tag to the head.
hints: Hint 1: Inside the media query, set .grid { display: flex; gap: 16px; }.
Hint 2: Add .grid .item { flex: 1 1 200px; } so items share the row.
Hint 3: Keep the default block layout outside the media query for phones.

quiz.question: What does a media query do?
options: Applies styles only in certain conditions

quiz.question: Which is the mobile-first approach?
options: Base = phone, media queries widen up
